title: Portuguese Speaking  Reporter  UK / Brazil
description:
Portuguese Speaking Reporter | €35K | Remote

We’re a global media and events leader at the centre of the iGaming B2B ecosystem — covering the technology, regulation, data, platforms, and commercial engines that power online gaming worldwide. This isn’t consumer‑facing content; it’s the heartbeat of the industry.

If you’re hungry to learn, thrive in fast‑paced news, and want to grow quickly in a sector that never stands still, this is your moment.

The Role

We’re looking for a sharp, ambitious Reporter to join our newsroom and help shape our editorial voice across Europe and Brazil.

You’ll cover daily iGaming news, support senior journalists, and—crucially—develop original stories that go beyond recycled press releases. This is an ideal first step for someone building a journalism career and eager to develop deep industry expertise.

What You’ll Do

  • Write and publish accurate, timely news across regulation, M&A, product launches, and market trends
  • Review, edit, and publish press releases for our B2B News Support package
  • Maintain high editorial standards, sourcing, and attribution
  • Optimise headlines, metadata, and internal linking
  • Build a source tracker and grow toward original reporting, exclusives, and first‑hand stories
  • Produce 4–6 high‑quality stories per week , with a focus on originality, insight, and fresh angles
  • Help shape our brand voice and act as a strong editorial ambassador
  • Contribute to educating and expanding our presence in the Brazilian market

What You Bring

  • Journalism or editorial experience
  • Fluent Portuguese (essential)
  • Proven experience in the iGaming sector (essential)
  • Strong grammar, accuracy, and headline instincts
  • Ability to turn press releases into engaging B2B news
  • Organised, reliable, and deadline‑driven
  • Based in the UK

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong iGaming industry contacts and a passion for uncovering first‑hand stories
  • Curiosity, motivation, and the confidence to pursue stories even when they challenge industry narratives
  • SEO knowledge
  • Ambition to build sources and break stories

What’s In It for You

  • Ownership of our Press Release Support product
  • Fast progression toward explainers, features, and exclusives
  • A real opportunity to shape editorial identity and influence a fast‑growing brand

Benefits

  • Private health insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme & retail discounts
  • Flexible, remote‑friendly working

Why Join Us

You’ll be part of a fast‑growing, ambitious team where your work is seen, valued, and genuinely impactful. We champion curiosity, initiative, and growth — and we’ll support you in becoming a trusted voice in iGaming journalism, with a meaningful role in shaping how the industry is understood across Europe and Brazil.

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Supervisor(a) de Estúdio
description:
Vaga: Supervisor(a) de Estúdio

Local: Escritório Pinheiros – São Paulo/SP | Modelo: 100% Presencial

Nível: Sênior


Chegou a sua hora de liderar a operação que transforma produto em imagem de alta performance!

No e-commerce da Centauro, o estúdio é um pilar estratégico da experiência do cliente. Cada foto e vídeo precisa traduzir qualidade, consistência visual e agilidade, respeitando o Style Guide da marca e os prazos do varejo.

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Estúdio para atuar como guardião da eficiência operacional e da excelência técnica, liderando o ciclo completo da produção visual — do planejamento dos calendários à entrega dos resultados — com foco em qualidade, dados e escalabilidade.


Seus desafios no jogo:

  • Atuar como aprovador(a) final da produção técnica e estética de fotos e vídeos, garantindo consistência de luz, cor, enquadramento e styling;
  • Manter e evoluir o Style Guide e os manuais de luz, assegurando padronização e identidade visual da marca;
  • Analisar causas de refações e rejeições, implementando melhorias imediatas nos processos e no set;
  • Planejar e gerenciar o calendário de shootings, coordenando prazos entre modelos, freelancers e times internos;
  • Gerir o fluxo completo das peças no estúdio, desde o recebimento até a entrega final para o e-commerce;
  • Liderar o time técnico (fotografia, vídeo, styling e edição), garantindo produtividade e cumprimento de SLAs;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios de produtividade, custos e qualidade para a liderança e diretoria.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Superior completo em Fotografia, Publicidade e Propaganda, Moda, Design, Comunicação, Administração, Produção Audiovisual ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida na liderança de estúdios de moda ou e-commerce de alto volume;
  • Domínio do fluxo de produção visual ponta a ponta (planejamento, captura, edição e entrega);
  • Olhar crítico e técnico para auditoria de qualidade de imagem e vídeo;
  • Forte capacidade de organização, gestão de cronogramas e tomada de decisão sob pressão;
  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para transformar operação em dados e KPIs;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times internos, parceiros externos e liderança.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de fluxo e estúdio (Creative Force, ShotFlow, Monday, Airtable ou similares);
  • Vivência em operações de e-commerce de grande escala e alta cadência de produção;
  • Conhecimento em controle de custos e otimização financeira (custo por SKU, refação, horas extras);
  • Noções de pós-produção para melhor integração com o time de edição;
  • Experiência na gestão de freelancers, casting e fornecedores audiovisuais.


O que você encontra por aqui:

  • Atuação em uma operação de estúdio estratégica e de alto impacto no e-commerce;
  • Interface direta com áreas de E-commerce, Produto, Comercial e Diretoria;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a dados e resultados;
  • Autonomia para implementar melhorias de processo, qualidade e produtividade;
  • Oportunidade de liderar e escalar uma operação visual em constante evolução.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.


They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.


Required Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


This is a CRT Role at R$18,000/month + Annual Bonus

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.


They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.


Required Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


This is a CRT Role at R$18,000/month + Annual Bonus

title: Product Owner SR
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Product Owners experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Product Owner trabalhará com equipes de ágeis para evolução da maturidade de produto e maximização da entrega de valor em ambiente Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Garantir a elaboração, refinamento e priorização continua o Backlog da equipe ágil de acordo com DoR estabelecido;
  • Entender, contribuir e influenciar os aspectos de negócios que compõem o Backlog do produto;
  • Interagir com Product Manager, Business Owners, SMEs e outros Product Owners para elaboração de Features e User Stories;
  • Colaborar na elaboração das Features e elaborar User Stories incluindo critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos;
  • Analisar Features e User Stories com Product Manager e outras partes interessadas para garantir que atendam às necessidades do cliente;
  • Participar continuamente das rotinas e cerimônias do time ágil; facilitar as discussões, fornecer esclarecimento, refinar user stories e critérios de aceitação, validar e aceitar entregas de produto;
  • Contribuir para atividades de design de soluções e decisões de produto;
  • Compreender os requisitos de segurança e compliance; estabelecer integração perfeita com as equipes de segurança cibernética e conformidade;
  • Utilizar ferramentas para planejar e rastrear User Stories, critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos de produto;
  • Fornecer status sobre o progresso dos objetivos de negócios sob responsabilidade da equipe ágil;
  • Liderar esforços para identificação e resolução definitiva de problemas de produção;
  • Participar de cerimônias de Sincronizações do Agile Release Train (PO Synch);
  • Organizar e facilitar Sprint DEMO's para os demais integrantes do Agile Release Train;


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner (conhecimento será testado);
  • Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do Scrum e SAFe;
  • Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil.

Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

  • Possuir certificação CSPO ou PSPO
  • Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

  • English

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior (Go & Type)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.


O seu papel como Software Engineering Backend:

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Product Owner SR
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Product Owners experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Product Owner trabalhará com equipes de ágeis para evolução da maturidade de produto e maximização da entrega de valor em ambiente Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Garantir a elaboração, refinamento e priorização continua o Backlog da equipe ágil de acordo com DoR estabelecido;
  • Entender, contribuir e influenciar os aspectos de negócios que compõem o Backlog do produto;
  • Interagir com Product Manager, Business Owners, SMEs e outros Product Owners para elaboração de Features e User Stories;
  • Colaborar na elaboração das Features e elaborar User Stories incluindo critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos;
  • Analisar Features e User Stories com Product Manager e outras partes interessadas para garantir que atendam às necessidades do cliente;
  • Participar continuamente das rotinas e cerimônias do time ágil; facilitar as discussões, fornecer esclarecimento, refinar user stories e critérios de aceitação, validar e aceitar entregas de produto;
  • Contribuir para atividades de design de soluções e decisões de produto;
  • Compreender os requisitos de segurança e compliance; estabelecer integração perfeita com as equipes de segurança cibernética e conformidade;
  • Utilizar ferramentas para planejar e rastrear User Stories, critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos de produto;
  • Fornecer status sobre o progresso dos objetivos de negócios sob responsabilidade da equipe ágil;
  • Liderar esforços para identificação e resolução definitiva de problemas de produção;
  • Participar de cerimônias de Sincronizações do Agile Release Train (PO Synch);
  • Organizar e facilitar Sprint DEMO's para os demais integrantes do Agile Release Train;


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner (conhecimento será testado);
  • Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do Scrum e SAFe;
  • Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil.

Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

  • Possuir certificação CSPO ou PSPO
  • Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

  • English

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Product Owner SR
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Product Owners experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Product Owner trabalhará com equipes de ágeis para evolução da maturidade de produto e maximização da entrega de valor em ambiente Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Garantir a elaboração, refinamento e priorização continua o Backlog da equipe ágil de acordo com DoR estabelecido;
  • Entender, contribuir e influenciar os aspectos de negócios que compõem o Backlog do produto;
  • Interagir com Product Manager, Business Owners, SMEs e outros Product Owners para elaboração de Features e User Stories;
  • Colaborar na elaboração das Features e elaborar User Stories incluindo critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos;
  • Analisar Features e User Stories com Product Manager e outras partes interessadas para garantir que atendam às necessidades do cliente;
  • Participar continuamente das rotinas e cerimônias do time ágil; facilitar as discussões, fornecer esclarecimento, refinar user stories e critérios de aceitação, validar e aceitar entregas de produto;
  • Contribuir para atividades de design de soluções e decisões de produto;
  • Compreender os requisitos de segurança e compliance; estabelecer integração perfeita com as equipes de segurança cibernética e conformidade;
  • Utilizar ferramentas para planejar e rastrear User Stories, critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos de produto;
  • Fornecer status sobre o progresso dos objetivos de negócios sob responsabilidade da equipe ágil;
  • Liderar esforços para identificação e resolução definitiva de problemas de produção;
  • Participar de cerimônias de Sincronizações do Agile Release Train (PO Synch);
  • Organizar e facilitar Sprint DEMO's para os demais integrantes do Agile Release Train;


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner (conhecimento será testado);
  • Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do Scrum e SAFe;
  • Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil.

Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

  • Possuir certificação CSPO ou PSPO
  • Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

  • English

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Arquiteto (a) Salesforce - Remoto
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Pre-Requisites:


  • Advanced English


  • Required minimum of 10+ years of experience in Salesforce Data Cloud and Salesforce Marketing Cloud to Collaborate with clients to understand their business objectives and requirements, and design solutions to meet the needs


  • Architect and design robust and scalable Salesforce Data Cloud solutions based on client requirements and industry best practices.


  • Work with practitioners on Salesforce Marketing Cloud and help build marketing capabilities and assets using data cloud.


  • Understand functional requirements and should be able to develop technical design using standard patterns and be able to communicate the same effectively to the team members.


  • Define and implement data modelling, schema design, and data governance strategies within the Salesforce Data Cloud.


  • Implement seamless integrations between Salesforce Data Cloud and third-party systems, such as marketing automation, analytics, and Salesforce CRM


  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business objectives.


  • Salesforce certifications in Salesforce DataCloud


Roles and Responsibilities:



  • Design and implement scalable data models, build ERD diagrams


  • Build/configure ingestion, data modeling, segmentation and activation within Salesforce Data Cloud and have an understanding of the various cloud platforms that Salesforce data cloud can integrate specifically with Marketing cloud.


  • Design and implement Data 360 data models, including Data Streams, Data Bundles, Data Lake Objects (DLOs), and Data Model Objects (DMOs).


  • Build and maintain data transformations, including Data Mapper recipes, identity resolution rules, and calculated insights.


  • Create scalable segmentation, activation, and unification


  • pipelines to support personalization and analytics use cases.


  • Optimize data ingestion performance with monitoring, validation, and exception handling processes.


  • Implement real-time and batch data synchronization across enterprise systems and Salesforce clouds.


  • Establish best practices for Data Cloud usage, performance tuning, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (HOME OFFICE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

operational considerations).

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Arquiteto (a) Salesforce - Remoto
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Pre-Requisites:


  • Advanced English


  • Required minimum of 10+ years of experience in Salesforce Data Cloud and Salesforce Marketing Cloud to Collaborate with clients to understand their business objectives and requirements, and design solutions to meet the needs


  • Architect and design robust and scalable Salesforce Data Cloud solutions based on client requirements and industry best practices.


  • Work with practitioners on Salesforce Marketing Cloud and help build marketing capabilities and assets using data cloud.


  • Understand functional requirements and should be able to develop technical design using standard patterns and be able to communicate the same effectively to the team members.


  • Define and implement data modelling, schema design, and data governance strategies within the Salesforce Data Cloud.


  • Implement seamless integrations between Salesforce Data Cloud and third-party systems, such as marketing automation, analytics, and Salesforce CRM


  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business objectives.


  • Salesforce certifications in Salesforce DataCloud


Roles and Responsibilities:



  • Design and implement scalable data models, build ERD diagrams


  • Build/configure ingestion, data modeling, segmentation and activation within Salesforce Data Cloud and have an understanding of the various cloud platforms that Salesforce data cloud can integrate specifically with Marketing cloud.


  • Design and implement Data 360 data models, including Data Streams, Data Bundles, Data Lake Objects (DLOs), and Data Model Objects (DMOs).


  • Build and maintain data transformations, including Data Mapper recipes, identity resolution rules, and calculated insights.


  • Create scalable segmentation, activation, and unification


  • pipelines to support personalization and analytics use cases.


  • Optimize data ingestion performance with monitoring, validation, and exception handling processes.


  • Implement real-time and batch data synchronization across enterprise systems and Salesforce clouds.


  • Establish best practices for Data Cloud usage, performance tuning, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (HOME OFFICE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.
